fields.name: Compliance status
fields.description: Worst status across the linked packaging units. Only requirements already in force count.
fields.formula: if(count(field('Packaging')) = 0, 'No packaging linked', if(count(filter(field('Packaging'), totext(lookup('Packaging', 'Compliance status')) = 'Remediation required')) > 0, 'Remediation required', if(count(filter(field('Packaging'), totext(lookup('Packaging', 'Compliance status')) = 'Evidence missing')) > 0, 'Evidence missing', if(count(filter(field('Packaging'), totext(lookup('Packaging', 'Compliance status')) = 'Under review')) + count(filter(field('Packaging'), totext(lookup('Packaging', 'Compliance status')) = 'Not assessed')) > 0, 'Under review', 'Compliant'))))

fields.name: Upcoming gap count
fields.description: Failed assessments against requirements that are not in force yet, across the linked packaging units.

fields.name: Recyclability grade
fields.description: Annex II grades: A = at least 95%, B = at least 80%, C = at least 70% recyclable by weight. Entered by a reviewer.

fields.name: Retention period (years)
fields.description: How long to keep the technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity: 5 years for single-use, 10 for reusable packaging.

fields.name: Recycled plastic share (%)
fields.description: Indicator per packaging unit. The regulation measures recycled content as an average per manufacturing plant and year.
fields.formula: if(field('Plastic weight (g)') = 0, 0, round(sum(lookup('Component', 'Recycled plastic weight (g)')) / field('Plastic weight (g)') * 100, 0))

fields.name: Compliance status
fields.description: Worst status across this unit’s assessments. Only requirements already in force count.
fields.formula: if(count(field('Assessment')) = 0, 'Not assessed', if(count(filter(field('Assessment'), totext(lookup('Assessment', 'Compliance status')) = 'Remediation required')) > 0, 'Remediation required', if(count(filter(field('Assessment'), totext(lookup('Assessment', 'Compliance status')) = 'Evidence missing')) > 0, 'Evidence missing', if(count(filter(field('Assessment'), totext(lookup('Assessment', 'Compliance status')) = 'Under review')) > 0, 'Under review', 'Compliant'))))

rows.field_85464: The combined concentration of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium in packaging or packaging components must not exceed **100 mg/kg**. Show compliance in the technical documentation.

Food-contact packaging must not contain PFAS at or above:

- **25 ppb** for any single PFAS (targeted analysis)
- **250 ppb** for the sum of PFAS (targeted analysis)
- **50 ppm** for all PFAS, including polymeric PFAS

If total fluorine exceeds 50 mg/kg, the supplier must provide proof of what it consists of on request.

rows.field_85434: Technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity
rows.field_85464:
Before placing packaging on the market, run the conformity assessment, draw up the technical documentation (Annex VII) and an EU declaration of conformity.

- Keep both for **5 years** (single-use) or **10 years** (reusable)
- Provide them within **10 days** of a national authority's request

Suppliers must give you the information you need for this (Article 16).

rows.field_85434: Minimal empty space in sales packaging
rows.field_85464: Whoever fills sales packaging must reduce empty space to the minimum needed for the packaging to work, including protecting the product.

rows.field_85434: Compostable tea bags, coffee units and fruit stickers
rows.field_85464:
Permeable tea, coffee or other beverage bags, soft single-serve units used and disposed of with the product, and sticky labels on fruit and vegetables must be compostable in industrially controlled conditions.

Not tracked: none of these formats is in the product range.

Packaging must carry a harmonised, pictogram-based label showing its material composition, to help consumers sort it.

Applies from 12 August 2028 or 24 months after the Commission's implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later.

rows.field_85434: Recyclable packaging, grade A to C
rows.field_85464:
Packaging must be designed for recycling and reach recyclability performance **grade A** (at least 95%), **B** (at least 80%) or **C** (at least 70%) by weight.

Applies from 1 January 2030 or 24 months after the design-for-recycling delegated acts enter into force, whichever is later.

Packaging must be designed so its weight and volume are the minimum needed for it to function. Features that only increase perceived volume, such as double walls, false bottoms and unnecessary layers, are not allowed, with narrow exceptions.

Whoever fills grouped, transport or e-commerce packaging must keep the empty space ratio at or below **50%**.

Applies from 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the calculation methodology is adopted, whichever is later.

The packaging formats listed in Annex V may no longer be placed on the market. Point 1 covers **single-use plastic grouped packaging** used at the point of sale to encourage buying more than one product (for example shrink wrap), unless the grouping is needed for handling.

The Commission publishes guidelines with examples by 12 February 2027.

For contact-sensitive packaging made mainly of PET, except single-use plastic beverage bottles.

Each plastic part must contain at least **30%** recycled content recovered from post-consumer plastic waste, calculated as an average per manufacturing plant and year. Rises to **50%** from 1 January 2040.

Applies from 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act on the calculation method enters into force, whichever is later. Exemptions include compostable plastic packaging and any plastic part under 5% of the total weight of the packaging unit.

For contact-sensitive packaging made of plastics other than PET, except single-use plastic beverage bottles.

Each plastic part must contain at least **10%** recycled content recovered from post-consumer plastic waste, calculated as an average per manufacturing plant and year. Rises to **25%** from 1 January 2040.

Applies from 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act on the calculation method enters into force, whichever is later. Exemptions include compostable plastic packaging and any plastic part under 5% of the total weight of the packaging unit.

rows.field_85434: Recycled content, single-use plastic beverage bottles
rows.field_85464:
For single-use plastic beverage bottles.

Each plastic part must contain at least **30%** recycled content recovered from post-consumer plastic waste, calculated as an average per manufacturing plant and year. Rises to **65%** from 1 January 2040.

Applies from 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act on the calculation method enters into force, whichever is later. Exemptions include compostable plastic packaging and any plastic part under 5% of the total weight of the packaging unit.

For all other plastic packaging.

Each plastic part must contain at least **35%** recycled content recovered from post-consumer plastic waste, calculated as an average per manufacturing plant and year. Rises to **65%** from 1 January 2040.

Applies from 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act on the calculation method enters into force, whichever is later. Exemptions include compostable plastic packaging and any plastic part under 5% of the total weight of the packaging unit.

Packaging must also be collected, sorted and **recycled at scale**, not only designed for recycling.

Applies from 1 January 2035 or 5 years after the implementing acts on the methodology enter into force, whichever is later. Not tracked until the methodology is published.

rows.field_85434: Recyclability grade A or B only
rows.field_85464: Packaging may only be placed on the market if it reaches recyclability **grade A or B**. Grade C packaging has to be redesigned before then.

fields.name: Is evidence missing
fields.description: True when no document is linked, or any linked document is expired or rejected.
fields.formula: or(count(field('Evidence')) = 0, count(filter(field('Evidence'), or(lookup('Evidence', 'Is expired'), totext(lookup('Evidence', 'Review status')) = 'Rejected'))) > 0)

fields.name: Recycled content gap
fields.formula: if(sum(lookup('Requirement', 'Minimum recycled content (%)')) = 0, '', if(sum(lookup('Packaging unit', 'Recycled plastic share (%)')) >= sum(lookup('Requirement', 'Minimum recycled content (%)')), concat('Meets minimum by ', totext(sum(lookup('Packaging unit', 'Recycled plastic share (%)')) - sum(lookup('Requirement', 'Minimum recycled content (%)'))), ' percentage points'), concat(totext(sum(lookup('Requirement', 'Minimum recycled content (%)')) - sum(lookup('Packaging unit', 'Recycled plastic share (%)'))), ' percentage points below minimum')))

fields.name: Compliance status
fields.description: Calculated from the review status, whether the requirement is in force, and the linked evidence.
fields.formula: if(totext(field('Review status')) = 'Not applicable', 'Not applicable', if(field('Is requirement in force'), if(totext(field('Review status')) = 'Failed', 'Remediation required', if(field('Is evidence missing'), 'Evidence missing', if(and(totext(field('Review status')) = 'Passed', count(filter(field('Evidence'), lookup('Evidence', 'Is valid'))) = count(field('Evidence'))), 'Compliant', 'Under review'))), if(totext(field('Review status')) = 'Failed', 'Gap before deadline', if(totext(field('Review status')) = 'Passed', 'Ready before deadline', 'Upcoming'))))

fields.name: Is corrective action needed
fields.description: True when the assessment failed and no action is linked yet. The corrective action automation uses it so it never creates the same action twice.
